title: Projection-Free Algorithms for Nonsmooth Stochastic Convex-Concave Saddle-Point Problems
summary: We study nonsmooth convex-concave saddle-point problems over compact convex sets, assuming access to stochastic subgradients of the payoff function. We develop single-loop projection-free algorithms that use linear minimization oracles over the primal and dual domains. Unlike prior projection-free approaches that rely on smoothing, our methods are purely subgradient-based and handle nonsmoothness directly. This design makes the framework modular: when a linear minimization oracle is not used over a specific domain, the corresponding update can be replaced by a standard projection oracle…
